item.title: District Electoral Divisions - 03 May 1921
item.description: NI District Electoral Divisions as they stood on 3 May 1921, the commencement of the Government of Ireland Act. Not yet digitised: no distinct 1921 NI DED boundary set is currently available. This entry previously served the 1930 NI DED dataset as a proxy, which risked implying the boundaries were unchanged between 1921 and 1930; it is now listed as to-be-added rather than served. For the 1930 boundaries see ded-1930-04-01.
